operating_notes.text: LME prices expected to average around US$ 3125 / MT for CY 2026.
Bauxite excavation reached 77.01 lakh tonnes and cast metal production reached 4.72 lakh tonnes in FY26.
Captive coal production from Utkal mines targeted at 4.8 million tons for FY27.
Q1FY27 alumina realisation was about $323/t, with Q2 expected near $370/t on Russian and Chinese refinery curtailments.
Domestic metal premium rose to about $110/t from $60/t, driven by Middle East war-related supply restrictions.
Captive coal landed cost is about ₹1,600/t versus ₹3,500-3,600/t for e-auction coal, a saving of about ₹1,500/t.
Board sought waiver for ₹14.13 lakh fines levied by BSE and NSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations.

timeline.summary: Nalco scheduled an earnings conference call for 30 April 2026 to discuss FY26 results
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,012.82 Cr (-4.8% YoY), net profit ₹1,722.44 Cr (-16.7% YoY).
National Aluminium Company Limited’s Board declared a ₹2 interim dividend per equity share (₹918.32 crore paid-up capital) for FY2025-26, payable by May 30, 2026, with May 8 as record date.
Nalco presented its Q4 FY26 earnings presentation on April 30, 2026
NALCO reported record FY26 revenue of ₹17,843 Cr and PAT of ₹5,816 Cr, announcing a 3rd interim dividend of ₹2 per share.
Nalcos earnings call transcript for Q4 and FY26 highlights record financial and physical performance across all operational segments.
Vivek Kumar Sharma, on behalf of the President of India, Ministry of Mines, Government of India, declared no encumbrance on National Aluminium Company Limited shares during FY2026.

Nalco's Q1FY27 earnings call on 3 August 2026 flagged a 2-3 month delay in 5th Stream refinery mechanical completion to September end and a ₹25,000 Cr smelter-plus-power expansion targeted for December 2030.
NALCO's board reviewed exchange fines of ₹14.13 lakh each for non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations and sought a waiver.
